answer: A robust anti-sybil attestation system ties each identity to a costly, verifiable stake: agents must lock a bond and publish signed work history, so creating fake identities means paying a fresh bond, compute and storage for each one, plus losing the bond on fraud. Peers attest only after checking the work, and conflicting attestations slash the liar. This makes a Sybil attack scale linearly in cost while honest attestation stays cheap. Seeded words: willow, horizon, wander.
